datasets.name: Bijie Landslide Dataset
datasets.verbatim: To test the proposed approach for landslide and mudslide detection, we integrated our developed dataset into a state-of-the-art benchmark dataset called the Bijie Landslide Dataset [26].

methods.name: Attention-enhanced region proposal network
methods.summary: The method integrates attention layers into the Faster R-CNN architecture. It uses a VGGNet-based feature map generation layer, an attention-enhanced region proposal extraction layer (combining RPN and multi-head self-attention for foreground determination and regression), and an ROI pooling and identification layer.
methods.source: Chong Niu, Kebo Ma, Xiaoyong Shen, Xiaoming Wang, Xiao Xie, Lin Tan, and Yong Xue
methods.verbatim: this paper integrates attentions into the architecture of state-of-the-art CNNs—including Faster RCNN—to develop an attention-enhanced region proposal network for multi-scale landslide/mudslide detection.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the attention-enhanced region proposal network lacks a repository or persistent link.
